scope: CH-04E independent local HTTP session-runtime integration tests

runs.note: New cancellation test omitted the existing required request_id. This was a test construction error, corrected without changing product code.

red_green_boundary: The product implementation was already present before this test file's first execution. No artificial rollback was performed. Product boundary RED evidence is maintained separately by the root and registry agents.
coverage: Actual authenticated HTTP-session actor, not the older fixture session
Different users and same-user distinct login-session grants
Single real loopback POST, authorization header, bounded payload and replay recovery
Shared policy call and amount limits survive second-session grant and reauthorization
Queued configuration and grant ABA produce proved not_sent without network
Sending configuration and grant ABA retain usage receipt but discard candidate
Concurrent session revocation affects only the revoked session
Replacement pricing does not alter an in-flight attempt's original estimated receipt
Cancellation retains received receipt; result lookup does not resend
Restart recovers reserved and sending markers without grants or automatic sends
Restored quarantine rejects generation even with a trusted current-session grant

transport.application: build_local_app through in-process ASGI TestClient with real lifespan and isolated SQLite workspace
transport.supplier: DeepSeekProvider.for_synthetic_loopback to a real ThreadingHTTPServer bound to 127.0.0.1:0

boundary: This validates the trusted server registry and loopback protocol. It does not validate Electron UI, browser rendering, external model service, or native credential-to-backend delivery.
